name: directory.stat
description: Stat a directory: returns entry count and mtime. For files, use file.stat. Read-only.

type.description: Always `directory` on success — this verb returns ERR not_a_directory for non-directories rather than reporting a different type.

entry_count.description: Count of immediate entries (subdirectories + files + links + other). Recursive descent NOT included — use directory.list and walk if recursive count is needed.

mtime_unix_s.description: Modification time as Unix epoch seconds. Updated by the OS when entries are added / removed / renamed in the directory.

flags.description: Win32 FILE_ATTRIBUTE_* flags currently set on the directory. Per issue #93 (extended to directory.stat for parity with file.stat).

x-implementations.name: get_file_attributes_ex_plus_count
x-implementations.description: Win32 `GetFileAttributesExW` (mtime + attributes + type check) + `FindFirstFileW` / `FindNextFileW` loop counting entries. Two passes over the directory metadata; cheap unless directories are huge.

windows-modern.description: GetFileAttributesExW + FindFirstFileW iteration for entry count. Long-path `\\?\` prefix automatic when input exceeds MAX_PATH.

windows-classic.description: GetFileAttributesA / GetFileAttributesW + FindFirst* per NT version. NT 4 / 9x use the ANSI variants; transcoded path handling.
